pages.text: {{hero}} lives by a deep green lake, and a kind dinosaur named Pip likes to play there. Pip is tall, with a long neck and spots on the tail. Each day, {{hero}} and Pip play tag by the lake.
One day, {{hero}} sees a tree with sweet green leaves high up at the top. {{hero}} wants to pick the leaves to make a snack for Pip. But the tree is so tall, and the leaves are way up high.
{{hero}} jumps and jumps, but the leaves stay high. {{hero}} stands on a big stone and reaches. Still, the leaves are way up at the top. {{hero}} sits down on the grass with a sigh.
Then Pip comes by and sees the tree. Pip stretches that long neck up and picks the leaves with ease. Pip drops a big pile next to {{hero}}. They eat the sweet snack in the shade.
When the sun sets, {{hero}} waves to Pip and heads home to bed. {{hero}} feels snug and safe. But that night, {{hero}} sees a soft light by the lake. Is it Pip? What is it?
